messages.subject: Project Meridian - Hartwell mark-up of the MSA
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Good to speak earlier. Our client's mark-up of the Master SaaS Subscription Agreement will follow. The headline points are the liability architecture (general cap plus a data/confidentiality super-cap), 24-hour breach notification, an express data-export right on exit, and a cap on the annual price uplift. None of these should be controversial for a regulated pharma customer.

Look forward to your comments.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0112

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Meridian - Hartwell mark-up of the MSA
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. We've taken instructions from Sentvia. We can move on breach notification and the export right. On liability we're more constrained - Sentvia's position is a 100% cap and a 150% super-cap rather than the numbers you've proposed, and they've asked for a modest increase to the price-uplift cap. Our redline is attached - I think we're close.

Marcus Ashworth
Partner | Ashworth Quinn LLP
DX 41214 London
